en: A black‑and‑white historic postcard depicting a large, ornate multi‑storey building on a busy square. The facade carries signs in Hungarian, including "Pécsi Takarékpénztár" (a savings bank) and shop signs at street level such as "Neumann M." The square in front is animated with pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, horse‑drawn carriages, market stalls and small trees. Handwritten cursive text overlays the upper part of the image. Printed captions in red at the top left and right read "Pécs." and "Takarékpénztári palota."
